name: @lmthing/dsh-subagent-preset
description: A SubagentProvider that composes each in-process child from a NAMED PRESET (via @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets), not the parent's own composition — the fix for the union-of-tools delegation fidelity gap documented in dsh/PROGRESS.md Part A2. A deliberate, minimal fork of @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-in-process-driver with one inserted recompose() call.
